subject: general
question:
Select the figure from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/79d33bae9c1259e0aff798d1de42db62cc5e76a0ccc3c321602063ccceeaad8b.png]
solution:
**Logic : The pattern followed followed here is diagonally.**

 
• **The shaded triangle is shifting diagonally alternately.**
 
• **After shifting diagonally , the shaded area shifts after one gap in the clockwise direction. **
 
• **The pervious shaded triangle is eliminated simultaneously.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b120db8c6ffad2b00882e97a9d4871704068d5d3914a41e02b055c5085aa2508.png] ​

Hence, **"Option - (4)"** is the correct answer.
